title: Range-Angle Position Estimator
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/Range_Angle_Position_Estimator.md
text: Estimate target positions using range-angle measurements, 5 inputs, 2 outputs; {Enable known variance input}, {Output covariances of position estimates} and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: RngEst
ports.summary: range measurement (meters) real-valued 1-by- K vector | real-valued J -by- L matrix

ports.name: AngEst
ports.summary: angle-of-arrival estimate (degrees) real-valued 1-by- L row vector | real-valued 2-by- L matrix

ports.name: RngVar
ports.summary: range variance (meters-squared) [] (default) | positive real-valued J -by- L matrix | positive real-valued length- K row vector

ports.name: AngVar
ports.summary: angle variance (degrees-squared) [] | real-valued 1-by- L row vector | real-valued 2-by- L matrix

ports.name: AnchorPos
ports.summary: Anchor positions (meters) real-valued Q -by- J matrix

ports.name: TgtPosEst
ports.summary: Target position estimate (meters) real-valued Q -by-1 vector

ports.name: TgtPosCov
ports.summary: Estimated target position covariance (meters-squared) real-valued Q -by- Q matrix | real-valued Q -by- Q -by- K array

params.name: Enable known variance input
params.values: Enable known variance input on (default) | off

params.name: Output covariances of position estimates
params.values: Output covariances of position estimates off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
